scope: Synthetic integration and real annotation-fetch smoke check; no biological accuracy claim

annotation.fdr_family: all requested annotations for this one target map
annotation.test: two-sided Pearson; annotation-side BrainSMASH spatial surrogates
annotation.coverage: common finite voxel domain; zeros retained unless explicitly excluded
annotation.interpretation: Spatial correspondence to reference maps, not receptor measurements
annotation.null_caveat: Independent blocks do not preserve cross-block covariance. Review variograms; generation does not certify null calibration.

benchmark.validation: Nested leave-one-subject-out; inner-test MSE selects component count
benchmark.baseline: Mean standardized PET map of outer-training subjects only
benchmark.interpretation: Experimental prediction of within-map standardized molecular spatial profiles, not absolute receptor density. No clinical accuracy or statistical significance is implied by these scores.
benchmark.limits: FC-only independent implementation; not full EigenBrain reproduction. Related participants and site effects need grouped/external validation. Reference independence is declared by supplied IDs, not independently verified.
